ตาม protocol ของ `design-audit` ผมรัน **30-Second & LIFT Audit Report** เสร็จแล้ว:

## 🔍 30-Second & LIFT Design Audit Report

## 📈 Executive Summary Score: **91 / 100**

| Audit Dimension | Status | Key Observations |
| :--- | :---: | :--- |
| **1. Speed & OG Sharing** | ✅ PASS | Single file, no JS framework, 3 font families via Google Fonts (preconnect). OG title/desc/image + `twitter:card` set. |
| **2. Work Visibility & Hero Hook** | ✅ PASS | Hero headline visible above the fold, product bento shown immediately on scroll — nothing hidden behind hover/click. |
| **3. Typography & Hierarchy** | ✅ PASS | 3 families (Fraunces serif + Archivo grotesque + Space Mono labels) — intentional pairing, not Inter. Major Third 1.25x scale. Headline `-0.025em` / `1.08` leading. |
| **4. Micro-Interactions** | ✅ PASS | Card hover bg-shift + red bar wipe, button 4-state (default/hover/active/disabled), marquee ticker, staggered reveal, animated counters. |
| **5. LIFT Composition** | ✅ PASS | **L** — one dominant serif hero (breaks grid to the right via glass card). **I** — kicker→headline→sub→CTA→card eye path. **F** — friction used sparingly (italic red em, grid break). **T** — holds at mobile (grid collapses 12→8→4). |
| **6. Trust & Conversion CTA** | ✅ PASS | CTA in Nav (sticky) + Hero + final CTA section ≈ every 700px. Stats section as social proof. |

## 🧠 UX Psychology (3-Brain) Score: **90 / 100**

| Brain Persona | Target | Status | Notes |
| :--- | :--- | :---: | :--- |
| **Brain #1: Survival/Safety** | Mental models | ✅ PASS | Logo top-left, nav top-right, hero center, footer bottom. Generous white space = "Space is Wealth". |
| **Brain #2: Emotional** | MAYA interrupts | ✅ PASS | Predictable structure + micro-breaks: italic red em, glass card offset 6%, red bar wipe on hover, marquee. |
| **Brain #3: Rational** | Chunking 3–4 | ✅ PASS | "Why Google" = exactly 4
